attchmntText: Techno Electric & Engineering Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Techno Electric reported consolidated revenue of 11,079 Mn for Q2 FY27, up 31% year-on-year. Profit after tax reached 1,585 Mn, a 52.4% increase. EBITDA was 1,814 Mn with a margin of 16.38%. Order inflow for the quarter was 15,284 Mn, bringing the total order book to approximately 101,000 Mn as of 30 September 2026. The company remains debt-free. In digital infrastructure, the Chennai Phase 1 campus is operational with customers onboarded. Noida Phase 0 with 500 kW IT load is live. Construction has started on the Andhra Pradesh facility with 2 MW facility load, targeted for H1 FY28. Smart metering installation is at 85% completion, with Madhya Pradesh fully installed.

attchmntText: Techno Electric & Engineering Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Techno Electric and Engineering Company Limited published extracts of its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 in Business Standard and Pioneer newspapers on 13 November 2026. Zuari Industries Limited board of directors approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 at a meeting held on 12 November 2026. A K Capital Services Limited published an advertisement on 13 November 2026 regarding the allotment of 1,219 equity shares to E1gistics Private Limited. The advertisement states that the shares were allotted pursuant to the Companies Act 2013 and SEBI regulations. The total paid-up capital increased by Rs. 1,219. The advertisement also mentions the issuance of 100 equity shares to various parties.

Techno Electric and Engineering Company Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding the Qualified Institutional Placement of Rs. 1250 crore. CARE Ratings Limited reported a deviation in fund utilization. The company revised the allocation for NERES XVI and NERGS-I Power Transmission Limited from Rs. 400 crore to Rs. 200 crore due to the cancellation of the NERGS-I project by the Government of India. The unutilized Rs. 200 crore was reallocated to Techno Infra Developers Private Limited for a data center in Chennai, increasing that allocation from Rs. 350 crore to Rs. 550 crore. The Board of Directors approved these changes on August 12, 2025. The report also noted that the share price declined to Rs. 850.15 as of October 30, 2026, representing a 41% drop from the QIP issue price of Rs. 1438 per share.

Techno Electric and Engineering Company Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 12 November 2026. The Board approved and took on record the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The statutory auditors, M/s. Walker Chandiok and Co. LLP, issued a review report dated 12 November 2026. The report noted trade receivables aggregating to 896.35 million pending settlement as of 30 September 2026. Management considers these balances fully recoverable. The auditor did not review interim financial information for eleven subsidiaries reflecting total assets of 15,791.86 million. Three other subsidiaries with total assets of 2,352.63 million were not reviewed by their auditors. The Board also approved the standalone financial results for the same period.

attchmntText: Techno Electric & Engineering Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Techno Electric and Engineering Company Limited has intimated the National Stock Exchange of India and BSE Limited regarding an analyst and investors conference call. The call is scheduled for November 13, 2026, at 3:30 PM IST. It will discuss the un-audited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Company representatives Mr. P. P. Gupta, Chairman and Managing Director, and Mr. Ankit Saraiya, Director and CEO, will participate. Dial-in numbers for India, Hong Kong, and Singapore are provided. Registration is available via a Diamond Pass link. The intimation is submitted pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.
